==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Sep&min=Sep&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/SepTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Sep&min=Sep&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
// Verify.Sep: Verifies csv through Sep: a csv scrubber and a SepReader converter, with per column ignore, scrub and translate.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.Sep
// Note: Guid and date values are respected by Verify's counters, so an untranslated cell becomes
// Guid_1, Date_1 and so on.
// Note: A Sep SepReader can be verified directly, through a registered file converter:
// Verify(reader).
// Note: It hooks csv as a scrubber, so it also scrubs the csv per sheet that Verify.OpenXml writes
// for a workbook.
// Note: Verify.Sep and Verify.CsvHelper both add a csv scrubber and define the same settings
// method names, so referencing both fails to compile.
// Note: TranslateCsvColumns on VerifySettings and TranslateCsvColumn on SettingsTask are the same
// feature under two names, and neither is in the readme.
// Note: Verify.Sep is pre 1.0 (0.2.0) and targets net8.0 only.
public class SepTests
{
    // A csv is scrubbed before it is written: each Guid and date goes through Verify's counters,
    // so the snapshot reads Guid_1 and Date_1 and stays stable across runs.
    [Fact]
    public Task Csv()
    {
        return Verify(SampleCsv(), "csv");
    }

    // The csv the samples verify, built in code so there is no fixture file to add.
    static MemoryStream SampleCsv() =>
        new(
            """
            Index,Customer Id,First Name,Last Name,Country,Dob
            1,1f9d5b0c-1b6b-4f7d-9a1a-2c3d4e5f6a7b,Sheryl,Baxter,Chile,2017-10-15
            2,2a8c4d1e-3f5b-4c6d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f,Preston,Lozano,Djibouti,2016-08-16
            3,3b7e6f2a-4c8d-4e9f-8a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b,Roy,Berry,Antigua,2015-05-21
            """u8.ToArray());
}
